research_notes: Initial research2026-10-01: frozen occupation, official personal biography, sworn Royal Commission transcript, broadcaster production/participant records, publisher metadata and reliable interviews. Frozen roster unchanged.

Career completeness gaps remain before Army entry and after discharge, including precise work-placement dates, party organiser term and all media/speaking contracts. Benefits, compensation and family care are not employer spells. No private zero inferred from Army-only frozen occupation.

Non-continuity matters: testimony establishes unpaid maternity absence and later paid return; exact boundaries unknown. Paid transition/leave around discharge requires reconciliation; no automatic11-year public total. Sick leave does not automatically terminate an employment spell.

Government transcript includes detailed personal medical history; only employment-relevant leave and placement facts retained. Public redacted statement PDF returned (400) Content length is too large:46312143; no confidential material accessed. Follow up accessible public statement text for exact dates.

Employer party statement alleges full-time work but comes from a political dispute, lacks contract dates and has unrelated spam footer. Keep claim attributed and seek independent payroll or contemporaneous self-description. Do not adopt unrelated allegations. All party work excluded regardless.

Television broadcast dates are observations, not employment dates. Need legal contracting parties, employee/self-employed status, substantive hours, preparation/filming terms and leave. SBS programme was a CJZ production, so government broadcaster identity cannot decide her employer sector.

Network Ten original returned403; accessible indexed profile and trade reporting confirm participation. Publisher original JavaScript-only; indexed publisher catalogue confirms publication. Broad full-time military searches yielded unrelated staff and national policy results, not person-specific whole-term proof. Next follow-up should target public service/contract records rather than repeat these searches.
Follow-up2026-10-02: official Parliamentary Library indexed table resolves second Senate commencement to1July2019. No employment hours or Army leave boundaries inferred.

Public Royal Commission2022redacted exhibit44-01.001 still exceeded web reader size limit: (400) Content length is too large:46312143. Ordinary download did not return data and was cancelled(exit130); no access controls bypassed.2024exhibit90-05.001 is scanned; screenshot response exposed text placeholders only, so pages were not visually read and no facts adopted. Public statement leads remain https://defenceveteransuicide.royalcommission.gov.au/publications/exhibit-44-01001-jlb000000010001-r-submission-senator-jacqui-lambie and https://defenceveteransuicide.royalcommission.gov.au/publications/exhibit-90-05001-jlb000000010041-statement-senator-jacqui-lambie .

Further exact-name/full-time/enlistment searches did not establish precise maternity/paid-return periods. Parliamentary source direct403 is source-specific; indexed primary table supports only the Senate date change. Next follow-up should obtain readable public redacted statement or person-specific service chronology; do not repeat broad Army-policy searches.

Follow-up2026-10-04: targeted Royal Commission, DVA, Army, permanent-force and regular-Army searches repeated the known 1989–March2000 service and discharge chronology but did not produce person-specific evidence that the whole spell was substantive full-time employment or resolve the unpaid maternity interval. Generic permanent-force material and evidence about other veterans were not used. Leave headline totals unknown and seek a readable service record or public redacted statement rather than repeating broad searches.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Person-specific1July2024Katter Hansard assertion explicitly distinguishes Lambie full-time soldier status from his own non-full-time service. Added this qualified supporting evidence rather than attributing military hours from rank; no whole-term status or duration calculation because exact paid-duty and unpaid-maternity components remain unresolved. Other FT hits concerned her staff, national forces, Lesley Pyecroft, Mick Bainbridge or other veterans and were rejected. Next public service/payroll summary or own dated statement separating maternity and medical leave; do not assume no leave from an aggregate ten-year service biography.
